post.summary: Preview or apply exact audit corrections
post.description:
Human sessions only; agent audit grants and bearer read tokens cannot mutate.
Use assessment_version=2 for criterion assessments. Preview is read-only,
requires no prior approval and returns exact action/column, blockers and
an actor-bound five-minute confirmation token. Final Apply supplies that
token and identical policy inputs, with a bounded Idempotency-Key.
Approval, ordinary lifecycle and durable per-card receipt commit in one
transaction. Task/criteria/policy/dependency/column/source drift is skipped
with recovery. Independent items continue; inspect every receipt.
Retry the identical body/key after a lost response. Authorized durable
receipts are returned before requiring fresh source; expired previews
require refresh only when no receipt exists. Network timeout means unknown
outcome, never nothing changed. Partial unread unrelated evidence does
not block otherwise valid v2 corrections. Imported history cannot apply.
Without assessment_version the legacy finding_ids/preview contract remains
approval-first and Backlog/Ready-only, including its persisted preview.
A malformed v2 request never falls back to legacy.
